mapper.select: select storyboard_id, work_id, chapter_id, chapter_title, content, word_count, source, status, reviewer_id, review_time, reject_reason, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time, remark from sys_work_storyboard where work_id = #{workId} order by chapter_id asc, storyboard_id asc

select storyboard_id, work_id, chapter_id, chapter_title, content, word_count, source, status, reviewer_id, review_time, reject_reason, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time, remark from sys_work_storyboard where storyboard_id = #{storyboardId}

select storyboard_id, work_id, chapter_id, chapter_title, content, word_count, source, status, reviewer_id, review_time, reject_reason, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time, remark from sys_work_storyboard where work_id = #{workId} and chapter_id = #{chapterId} limit 1
mapper.insert: insert into sys_work_storyboard (work_id, chapter_id, chapter_title, content, word_count, source, status, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time, remark) values (#{workId}, #{chapterId}, #{chapterTitle}, #{content}, #{wordCount}, #{source}, #{status}, #{createBy}, #{createTime}, #{updateBy}, #{updateTime}, #{remark})
mapper.update: update sys_work_storyboard set chapter_title = #{chapterTitle}, content = #{content}, word_count = #{wordCount}, source = #{source}, status = #{status}, reviewer_id = null, review_time = null, reject_reason = null, update_by = #{updateBy}, update_time = #{updateTime} where storyboard_id = #{storyboardId}
